meta.title: KVMFlow
meta.description: Control a real computer through an IP-KVM: record HID actions with before/after screenshots, let the agent turn a recording into a graph workflow with branches, waits, loops and human checkpoints, edit it on a Dify-style canvas, and replay it node by node with screen verification. Open the panel from the left sidebar, or dock it as a right-sidebar tab. Agent tools cover snapshots, keyboard and mouse, visual checks, recording, the node catalog, graph patches, single-node tests and run control. BIOS workflows tap a hotkey before you press the target's power button and start once video appears. Supports Radxa Linkr (public HTTP API, WebRTC live video, automatic mapping for non-16:9 captures); other KVM models are a driver-extension point. Data lives under DSH_HOME/kvmflow (configurable with dataDir).
